keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «물병이 거의 비어 있었다(문제)» 와 «사막에서는 물이 진짜 금이다(교훈)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (their water bottles were almost empty) and the lesson (in the desert, water is the real gold). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Their water was almost gone in the hot desert.
They found a well full of clean water behind an old stone door.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

qs.q: Why could Sami and Grandpa see the stone door in the morning?
qs.qko: 사미와 할아버지는 왜 아침에 돌문을 볼 수 있었나요?
opts: The wind had blown away a hill of sand.
Grandpa dug a big hole all night.
The camels found it and pushed it.
evs: They hid behind a rock and waited all night.
In the morning, the wind had blown away a whole hill of sand.
They drank and drank, and they filled every bottle.
They were looking for the lost city of gold from Grandpa's old stories.
why: 밤새 모래 폭풍이 불어서, 아침이 되자 바람이 모래 언덕 하나를 통째로 날려 버렸어요. 그 아래에 돌문이 있었어요. 할아버지가 땅을 팠다는 말은 없어요.
The sandstorm blew all night, and by morning the wind had blown away a whole hill of sand. The door was under it. Grandpa did not dig.

qs.q: Grandpa says, "In the desert, water is the real gold." What does he mean?
qs.qko: 할아버지가 "In the desert, water is the real gold."라고 해요. 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: Water is the most precious thing in the desert.
Water turns into gold in the desert.
Gold is easy to find in the desert.
evs: Sami understood that the most valuable thing is what keeps you alive.
On the third day, a huge sandstorm hit them.
Sami and his grandfather crossed the hot desert on two camels.
Under it was an old stone door!
why: 사미는 가장 귀한 것은 우리를 살려 주는 것이라는 걸 깨달았어요. 사막에서는 물이 없으면 살 수 없으니, 물이 금보다 귀하다는 뜻이에요. 물이 진짜 금으로 변한다는 말이 아니에요.
Sami understood that the most valuable thing is what keeps you alive. In the desert, you cannot live without water, so water is more precious than gold. Water does not really turn into gold.

qs.q: Why were Sami and Grandpa so happy to find a well instead of gold?
qs.qko: 사미와 할아버지는 금 대신 우물을 찾았는데 왜 그렇게 기뻐했나요?
opts: Their water was almost gone, and the well gave them clean water.
They did not like gold at all.
The well was full of gold coins.
evs: But their water bottles were almost empty.
On the third day, a huge sandstorm hit them.
There was no gold inside, only a deep, cool well full of clean water.
Sami and his grandfather crossed the hot desert on two camels.
why: 물병이 거의 비어 있었는데, 문 안에는 깨끗한 물이 가득한 우물이 있었어요. 목이 마른 두 사람에게는 금보다 물이 더 필요했어요.
Their water bottles were almost empty, and the well was full of clean water. They needed water more than gold.

ends: Sami brings the people of his village to the secret well.
사미가 마을 사람들을 비밀 우물로 데려와요.
Sami and Grandpa find an old map in the stone room.
사미와 할아버지가 돌방에서 오래된 지도를 발견해요.

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «함께 할 일 + 그 목적» 으로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write something to do together and its purpose in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «so that» 뒤에는 «누가 + 무엇을 할 수 있다» 를 쓰세요. (예: so that we can drink)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «so that», write who + what they can do. (e.g. so that we can drink)

img.cover: In the golden desert, a boy with short curly black hair in a white tunic and a blue head scarf pushes open a heavy stone door half buried in the sand, and cool light shines on a round stone well full of sparkling water inside, while an old man with a long white beard in a brown robe and a straw hat leans forward in surprise beside two resting camels.

scenes.1: In a wild orange sandstorm, a boy with short curly black hair in a white tunic and a blue head scarf and an old man with a long white beard in a brown robe and a straw hat huddle behind a huge rock with two camels lying down beside them, while sand swirls all around.
scenes.3: In a cool, shady stone room, a boy with short curly black hair in a white tunic and a blue head scarf fills a water bottle at a round stone well while an old man with a long white beard in a brown robe and a straw hat laughs and drinks from a cup, with more bottles lined up on the floor.
